mobbin:98032d4a-7cd9-4d93-8993-43d0df586.summary: From the Curriculum outline the user opens an empty lesson, picks Text & Images, edits it in a focused editor, and saves the block.
steps: Text and images block: blank editor
Text and images block: filled and Save
Lesson with TEXT & IMAGES block and Outline
steal: Each lesson row shows whether it has content ('Empty' or '1 Text & Images') next to Publish or Published (screen 1).
The 'Add content' panel groups content blocks and teaching tools, with Quiz next to the media blocks (screen 2).
Each block opens in its own editor with Cancel and Save, instead of being edited on the long lesson page (screens 3-4).
A saved block is labelled TEXT & IMAGES with Edit and a drag handle, and the outline on the side marks the current lesson (screen 5).
avoid: Marketing tools (Upsell, Referrals) in the same 'Add content' list as teaching blocks should stay out of scenario building (screen 2).
mobbin:98032d4a-7cd9-4d93-8993-43d0df586.fit: Scenario manager: grow Briefing from a single video into orientation and pre-brief material built from blocks. The outline and draft-to-publish steps mirror the SCE structure without replacing the tabbed Details, Objectives, Patient and Equipment form.

mobbin:8c62da99-7eb3-46dd-9610-d7d932070.summary: From a lesson the user opens Add content, chooses Quiz, builds questions with answers and correct marks, and saves.
steps: Lesson editor: existing blocks and Add content
Add content panel with Quiz selected
Quiz block: Q1 answers and Correct answer hint
Quiz block: Q1 answers (hint still shown)
Quiz block: Q1 correct answer checked
Q1 collapsed and Q2 empty editor
Q2 filled with correct answer checked
Q2 with attached image and alt text
steal: A banner explains that grades will not be recorded on this plan, so it is clear answers are collected without scores (screens 3-4).
Each answer has a checkbox to mark it correct, allowing one or several correct answers, plus 'Add answer' (screens 3-4).
A finished question collapses and shows a check on the correct answer, while the next question stays open for editing (screen 6).
Each question can have an image, with alt text and a Replace option (screen 8).
avoid: Questions can only be added one at a time with '+ New question' and cannot be reused across quizzes. That is weak for faculty checklists, which need item banks shared across scenarios (screens 6-8).
mobbin:8c62da99-7eb3-46dd-9610-d7d932070.fit: Scenario manager: this supports checklists and knowledge checks for learners and faculty more than pre-brief videos. Quiz grading should stay lighter than the Enterprise Case Manager. Reusing items across scenarios is missing and needed.
